summary: The product card: gallery, price, buy box, advantages, delivery, characteristics, quick-filter chips. System section, one per product page. On phones it always renders the same stack with a sticky add-to-cart bar in `brandPrimary`; see references/product-page.md.
rules: Advantage types and texts are policy claims (try-on, returns, payment after try-on, split payment): only what the merchant confirms, each with its own `text`: the platform wording promises cash payment, pickup points and a courier whatever the store's settings. `split-payment` only with Split connected, `fitting` and `refusal` only for wearables with try-on. `presets apply` lists every set advantage in `open`; the lint warns on platform wording and on template slots (`advantages-unconfirmed`).

`images.autoplay`, `images.loop` and `images.order` control the product video, not the photo grid. Their schema defaults differ between storefront builds (false/false in older ones, true/true in newer), so always write them.

Always write `format`, `appearance`, `images.gap`, `images.initialGridCount`, `section.isFullscreen`, `section.paddingTop`, `modules.advantages.showElement` and `modules.delivery.showElement`: designed stores differ from the defaults exactly there, and the delivery default itself differs between builds (`collapsed` in older ones, `expanded` in newer).
`columns-3` prints the short description twice and gives the photo about a third of the width: only for catalog-led stores with a very short description.

Without configured logistics the delivery module prints a «we do not deliver to this city» line under the buy button. Preview the product page; if it shows, use `pdp-modules-prelaunch` and tell the merchant.

Quick-filter chips show every category and collection of the product, merchandising and seeded ones included. If a name is technical, switch the chips off or ask the merchant to rename it; breadcrumbs cannot be switched off, the category name is fixed in the cabinet.
Do not add root `isFullScreen` or `images.layout`: they are not settings of this widget.
Some stores keep an older layout with discount and split fields inside `appearance`; keep what the pulled section has.
The Split and Yandex points lines (`extras.yandexSplit`, `extras.yandexDiscount`) are the store's configuration: presets never write them, the pulled card keeps its values.

The line «До бесплатной доставки: N ₽» under the buy button is a theme switch, `delivery.enableProgress` (on by default), not a ProductDetails setting: it shows whenever the backend reports a threshold. Without a threshold the merchant confirmed, write `false` in the theme.

presets.name: pdp-classic-2col
presets.use: Safe default: two columns, contained gallery, a quiet xl title with a firm lg price (the pair of `pdp-quiet-title-firm-price`, which keeps the price on the first phone screen most often), delivery and advantages expanded. Keep product names to 40 characters or less.
presets.evidence: columns-2 with gap 100 on about 2 in 3 default product pages; a contained gallery on about 2 in 5; the xl regular title with an lg semibold price on about 3 in 10
fill: `modules.advantages.advantage1..6`: only the policies the merchant confirms (`pdp-advantages-policies`); `none` for the rest. Leave `text` out so the platform wording renders.

presets.name: pdp-edge-to-edge-gallery
presets.use: Image-led brands (apparel on models, accessories, objects) with 6 or more consistent photos: a long full-width photo grid glued to the header, sticky info column, quiet title and firm price.
presets.evidence: the quiet title + firm price pair on about 3 in 10 default product pages; gap 100 with 12 photos on about 1 in 3; full width with no top padding on about 1 in 5
fill: `modules.advantages.advantage1..6`: only the policies the merchant confirms (`pdp-advantages-policies`); `none` for the rest. Leave `text` out so the platform wording renders.
Only with 6 or more consistent photos per product; with fewer, `pdp-classic-2col`. Video autoplay and loop suit short silent loops only.

presets.name: pdp-quiet-title-firm-price
presets.use: Smaller regular title, firmer price. Merge into any product card when names run past about 40 characters or photos are 3:4: it is the title size that most often keeps the price on the first phone screen.
presets.evidence: the pair on about 3 in 10 default product pages; price on the first phone screen with an xl title in about 2 in 5 stores, with 2xl in about 1 in 10

presets.name: pdp-catalog-3col
presets.use: Catalog-led stores with many variants and specs, where the buy box matters more than the photo. Keep the short description very short: columns-3 prints it twice. Image-led brands stay on two columns.
presets.evidence: columns-3 on about 1 in 5 default product pages; this settings cluster in 3 stores, and in most of the other columns-3 stores the photo shrinks to about a third of the width
fill: `modules.advantages.advantage1..6`: only the policies the merchant confirms (`pdp-advantages-policies`); `none` for the rest. Leave `text` out so the platform wording renders.

presets.name: pdp-seamless-gallery
presets.use: Packshots that all share one backdrop: one gapless photo surface. Apply over `pdp-classic-2col` for the modules.
presets.evidence: gap 0 in 3 stores; the regular title with a bold price of the same size in 3 premium stores
fill: Only when every product photo sits on the same backdrop: mixed backgrounds turn the gapless surface into a patchwork.

presets.name: pdp-bold-brand
presets.use: Loud brands with a display font and short product names (about 25 characters or less): 3xl wraps longer names to 2-4 lines on phones and pushes the price below the sticky bar.
presets.evidence: 3xl bold with an xl bold price in 4 stores; 3xl titles on about 1 in 5 product pages, and the price reaches the first phone screen in about 1 in 8 of them

presets.name: pdp-advantages-policies
presets.use: Module preset: the advantages block as the merchant's confirmed policies, each in the merchant's own words. Merge over any product card.
presets.evidence: advantage types across the default product pages: delivery and payment on almost all, split payment on about 2 in 3, returns and try-on on about 3 in 5; copied free texts in about 3 in 5 stores, try-on on stores that sell no wearables in 4
fill: `modules.advantages.advantage1..3`: Each advantage slot a type and its own `text` from facts the merchant confirmed (payment methods, delivery options, the return window): the platform wording promises cash, pickup points and a courier (`delivery`: «Доставка в пункты выдачи или до двери», `payment`: «Оплата — картой, СБП или наличными»), so keep it only where it is true. `split-payment` only with Split connected; `fitting` and `refusal` only for wearables with try-on. No confirmed policy: every slot `none` or `enableAdvantages: false`.

presets.name: pdp-modules-prelaunch
presets.use: Store without configured logistics, or whose category and collection names are still technical (seeded or merchandising shelves): hides the «we do not deliver to this city» line and the chips that would expose those names.
presets.evidence: the refusal line under the buy button on about 4 in 5 desktop product captures where the module shows; seeded and merchandising names in the chips on most captures. No store in the sample switches delivery off, so its rendering is unverified: preview before publishing
fill: Tell the merchant what to fix in the cabinet (delivery zones and terms, category names); switch the modules back on once it is done.
`modules.advantages`: a `delivery` advantage still prints the platform's «Доставка в пункты выдачи или до двери»: set that slot to `none` or give it the merchant's own `text`.
The theme's `delivery.enableProgress`: without a free-delivery threshold the merchant confirmed, `false` (otherwise «До бесплатной доставки: N ₽» shows under the buy button).
